notes.title: Small Patch (v1.0.3)
notes.content:
Fixes

Some users reported not getting the "Welcome to the Sanctuary" & "New Immortal" achievements. Though rare, sometimes one-off achievement requests can fail to go through. So we've added a second check. Now whenever you enter the sanctuary, the game will check again if you should have these achievements & try to give them.



I also wanted to take a moment to say, thank you everyone for playing the game! We do appreciate it.



~Captain Cake

notes.title: Demo Update (0.7.30)
notes.content:
The demo is out & updated
We thought we didn't qualify for the Nextfest because our demo was still under review by Steam ~ Surprise! It was approved & we do qualify! So we released yesterday to a fantastic reception. We're very happy to receive all the positive feedback on the game & are working to improve it even further.

Full Changelog
Additions

 Added "Safe Mode". The game will prompt you to turn it on the first time you play the intro. You can turn it on/off in the settings. Some features in the game will be disabled if it was turned on & won't be re-enabled until you go back to the hub world.
 Added Sir Lash's portrait to the side of the shop screen.
 Created new art for the enemies that charge at the player.


Changes

 Reduced sprites file size.


Fixes

 Fixed a weight bug causing the Shrine of Virility to never spawn.
 Fixed map chunks sometimes not unloading data properly.
 Fixed player sometimes not having lighting on the hub world.


Lets play!

~Captain Cake

notes.title: Harem of Gods is here!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45182617/d96006abddbcf1b07cfc1eaaae8f58717fb3b9e1.png

Welcome Heroes & Adventurers!
We're happy you can join us for a project we've all been excited to talk about. Everyone on the team is a big fan of survivors games. We're split on what our favorite survivors-like game is so we've worked together to take inspiration from many different ones into something we're all proud of.

We're happy you find the game interesting, and we're excited to show it off. We hope to have a demo of the game for the Steam Nextfest this October 14th.

So if anything about this interests you, wishlist the game, and consider joining our awesome Discord community :D

Lets play!
